blocks.text: This article provides information on feature configuration use cases using APIs. All APIs are rate limited. To learn more, see Understanding Rate Limiting.
To get all feature configuration details:

blocks.item: Send a GET request to the following endpoint: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/{customerId}/configOverrides.
Provide the customerId, the ZPA tenant ID of the customer, in the request endpoint. For example: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/217316918451765248/configOverrides.
View an example response

blocks.heading: Getting a Particular Feature Configuration by ID

blocks.text: To get details of a particular feature configuration by ID:

blocks.item: Send a GET request to the following endpoint: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/{customerId}/configOverrides/{id}.
Provide the following in the request endpoint:
customerId: The ZPA tenant ID of the customer.
id: The unique identifier of the feature configuration.
For example: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/217316918451765248/configOverrides/221321.
View an example response

{ "id": "221321", "customerId": "217316918451765248", "customerName": "amehta", "targetType": "feature_flag", "targetGid": "0", "configKey": "config.feature.samesite_none", "configValue": "disabled", "sequence": "567303", "modifiedTime": "1753247506", "creationTime": "1753247506", "modifiedBy": "72057594038609323" }

blocks.text: A successful response returns code 200. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

blocks.heading: Creating a Feature Configuration for a Customer

blocks.text: To create a feature configuration for a customer:

blocks.item: Send a POST request to the following endpoint: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/{customerId}/configOverrides/.
Provide the customerId, the ZPA tenant ID of the customer, in the request endpoint. For example: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/217316918451765248/configOverrides/.
Include the request headers to provide information about the request context:
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
Provide the following JSON payload and include the following details:
configKey: The key for the feature configuration. The supported values are:
config.feature.samesite_none: Refers to the SameSite Cookie Attribute option when configuring authentication settings in ZPA.
config.feature.cors_enabled: Refers to the CORS Request option when configuring authentication settings in ZPA.
configValue: Indicates if the feature configuration is enabled (true) or disabled (false).
customerId: The ZPA tenant ID of the customer.
targetType: Indicates the target type of the feature configuration. The supported value is "feature_flag".
View the JSON payload
{ "customerId": <customer ID>, "targetType": "string", "configKey": "string", "configValue": "string" }
View an example JSON payload
{ "customerId": 217316918451765248, "targetType": "feature_flag", "configKey": "config.feature.samesite_none", "configValue": "disabled" }
View an example response

{ "id": "221321", "customerId": "217316918451765248", "targetType": "feature_flag", "targetGid": "0", "configKey": "config.feature.samesite_none", "configValue": "disabled", "modifiedTime": "1753247506", "creationTime": "1753247506", "modifiedBy": "72057594038609323" }

blocks.text: A successful response returns code 200. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

blocks.heading: Updating a Feature Configuration for a Customer

blocks.text: To update a feature configuration override for a customer:

blocks.item: Send a PUT request to the following endpoint: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/{customerId}/configOverrides/{id}.
Provide the following in the request endpoint:
customerId: The ZPA tenant ID of the customer.
id: The unique identiifer of the feature configuration.
For example: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/217316918451765248/configOverrides/221321.
Include the request headers to provide information about the request context:
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
Provide the following JSON payload and include the following details:
configKey: The key for the feature configuration. The supported values are:
config.feature.samesite_none: Refers to the SameSite Cookie Attribute option when configuring authentication settings in ZPA.
config.feature.cors_enabled: Refers to the CORS Request option when configuring authentication settings in ZPA.
configValue: Indicates if the feature configuration is enabled (true) or disabled (false).
customerId: The ZPA tenant ID of the customer.
targetType: Indicates the target type of the feature configuration. The supported value is "feature_flag".
View the JSON payload
{ "customerId": <customer ID>, "targetType": "string", "configKey": "string", "configValue": "string" }
View an example JSON payload
{ "customerId": 217316918451765248, "targetType": "feature_flag", "targetGid": 0, "configKey": "config.feature.samesite_none", "configValue": "enabled" }
View an example response

{ "id": "221321", "customerId": "217316918451765248", "targetType": "feature_flag", "targetGid": "0", "configKey": "config.feature.samesite_none", "configValue": "enabled", "sequence": "567303", "modifiedTime": "1753247506", "creationTime": "1753247506", "modifiedBy": "72057594038609323" }

blocks.text: A successful response returns code 200. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.
